_comment: Static test user definitions. Real passwords come from .env, not here.

standardUser._note: Primary test user — auth state saved by globalSetup for all non-login tests

lockedUser._note: Used ONLY in login tests — account is locked, cannot authenticate

errorUser._note: Used ONLY in login tests — simulates intermittent server errors

problemUser._note: Used in product, cart, and checkout regression tests — simulates UI rendering defects
